text:
clare: Quick thread  I'm updating the Embeddings quickstart (Python + Node) to address recurring confusions: the Node sample still uses old `embed()` interface, Python example prints raw vectors, and there's no tiny semantic-search example. Planning a small PR: modernize Node API to `client.embeddings.create`, add a safe Python snippet that doesn't print vectors, and include a 3-line semantic search example using cosine similarity. Anyone want to sanity-check?
noah: I can review the Node deltas. For Node, please show the async/await usage and include a note about batching for larger datasets. Many folks try to embed thousands of items one-by-one.
clare: Will do. Proposed Node snippet:
```js
// modern Node usage
const client = new RedwoodClient({ auth: await DefaultCredentials.load() });
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-small', input: ['hello world'] });
const vector = res.data[0].embedding; // store securely, do not log raw vectors
```
devrel: Add a red admonition: "Do not print embeddings in logs or commit them." Also include a 1-line migration note for folks moving from the old `embed()` helper: replace `client.embed(text)` with `client.embeddings.create({ model, input })` and map responses accordingly. Link to changelog.
sam-docs: For Python, show a safe storage pattern instead of printing: write to a local sqlite store or file with restricted permissions. Example: `store_vector(user_id, vector)` and a :no_entry_sign: note about PII.
clare: Good call. Python snippet I'll add:
```py
creds = DefaultCredentials.load()
client = RedwoodClient(auth=creds)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='open-embed-small', input=['hello world'])
vec = resp.data[0].embedding
store_vector(user_id, vec)  # do not print
```
noah: Also add a tiny semantic-search example (3 lines) showing cosine similarity on two vectors and a link to a small util function. That helps folks see immediate value.
clare: Plan to include a one-paragraph "When to use embeddings vs text-search" and a short note on unit costs with a pointer to Optimize tooling. Also adding a GH Actions sample for running the embed pipeline in CI with secrets via ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN }}.
devrel: CI note: suggest an example with `--batch-size 256` and mention memory/latency tradeoffs. Also add a short troubleshooter: common error `Payload too large` when embedding huge docs; suggest chunking.
ci-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/934-embed-quickstart-modernize  checks queued: markdown-lint, link-check, sample-runner.
sam-docs: I'll do a quick copyedit once the PR is up. Please ensure code fences have correct languages (`js` / `py` / `yaml`). If markdown-lint complains about long lines, trim.
clare: Thanks all. Aiming to merge after CI and a quick thumbs. I'll add a short CHANGELOG entry: "embeddings quickstart: modern API usage, safe storage patterns, semantic-search example, batching guidance".
noah: Nice. I'll watch for any follow-ups in support and spin up a small FAQ if needed. Thanks :rocket:
